## ⏱ Timer — `timer`

Start the flow on a schedule, or delay it when placed after another block.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` (Seconds) | number | `60` | Under 30 seconds the extension keeps its background worker awake to fire on time (Chromium). 30 seconds or more uses browser alarms. |
| `repeat` (Repeat) | boolean | `true` | Only used when this block starts the flow. After another block it always fires once. |

Adds to the data: `tick` (How many times the timer has fired (when it starts the flow).); `firedAt` (ISO time the timer fired.)

## 👁 Watch Element — `watch-element`

Fire when the text of a part of a web page changes.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selector` (Element) | locator | `""` | required |
| `url` (Page URL) | url | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `intervalSeconds` (Check every (seconds)) | number | `60` | Only used when this block starts the flow. After a Timer, the Timer decides. Under 30 seconds keeps the background worker awake. |
| `reload` (Reload page before checking) | boolean | `true` | Needed to see server-side changes. Turn off for pages that update themselves. |
| `emitOnFirstRead` (Fire on the first read too) | boolean | `false` | Off = the first read just records the starting value. |

Adds to the data: `value` (The new text of the element.); `previous` (The text before the change (null on the first read).); `url` (The page that was watched.); `selector` (The element selector.); `changedAt` (ISO time the change was noticed.)

## 🔗 Open Tab — `open-url`

Open a web page, and remember the tab for the next blocks.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 45s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` (URL) | url | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. Use {{name}} to insert a value from the previous block. |
| `where` (Open in) | one of `new`, `workflow`, `window`, `current` | `"new"` |  |
| `tab` (Tab name) | text | `"main"` | Later blocks find the tab by this name. Use another name (e.g. "admin") for a second tab. |
| `active` (Switch to it) | boolean | `true` | Off = open quietly in the background. |
| `waitUntil` (Continue when) | one of `load`, `networkidle`, `none` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The URL that was opened.); `tabId` (Id of the tab it was opened in.)

## 🧭 Navigate — `navigate`

Go to a URL, back, forward, or reload, in a tab of this run.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 45s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |
| `action` (Action) | one of `goto`, `back`, `forward`, `reload` | `"goto"` |  |
| `url` (URL) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `waitUntil` (Continue when) | one of `load`, `networkidle`, `none` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The URL after navigating.)

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

## 👆 Click — `click`

Click (or double-click, right-click, hover) an element. Waits until it can be clicked.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `action` (Action) | one of `click`, `double`, `right`, `hover` | `"click"` |  |
| `force` (Skip the checks) | boolean | `false` | Click even if the element looks hidden, disabled or covered. Only for stubborn pages. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

| `value` (Value) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `mode` (How) | one of `fill`, `type` | `"fill"` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

## 📋 Fill Form — `fill-form`

Fill several fields at once: text, selects, checkboxes. Optionally click submit.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` (Fields) | list of rows {locator, value} | `[]` | required. Empty values are skipped. Selects take the option text or value; checkboxes take true or false. |
| `submit` (Then click (optional)) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

## 🔽 Select Option — `select-option`

Choose an option in a dropdown (<select>), by its text or value.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")

- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Dropdown) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `value` (Option) | text | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. Several for a multi-select: separate with \| |

| `state` (Make it) | one of `check`, `uncheck` | `"check"` |  |

Press a key or shortcut: Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A…

- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` (Key) | text | `"Enter"` | required. Key names as on the keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, a, Control+A, Shift+Tab. |
| `locator` (On element (optional)) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Focus this element first. Empty = whatever has focus. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

## 🖱️ Scroll — `scroll`

Scroll to the bottom, top or an element; or keep scrolling until no more content loads.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 120s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` (Scroll) | one of `end`, `bottom`, `top`, `element` | `"end"` |  |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Only for "to an element". |
| `maxScrolls` (At most (scrolls)) | number | `20` |  |
| `pauseMs` (Wait between scrolls (ms)) | number | `1000` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `scrolls` (How many times it scrolled.)

## ⏳ Wait For — `wait-for`

Wait until an element appears or goes, some text shows, the URL changes, or the page settles.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` (Wait until) | one of `visible`, `hidden`, `attached`, `detached`, `enabled`, `text`, `no-text`, `url`, `load`, `networkidle` | `"visible"` |  |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For the element modes. For text: only look inside this element (optional). |
| `text` (Text) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `url` (URL pattern) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Plain text: the URL contains it. * matches any part between slashes, ** anything. /…/ is a regular expression. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `url` (The tab's URL when the wait ended.)

## 🔎 Read Element — `read-element`

Read a value from a page: text, attribute, class, whether it exists, or how many.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selector` (Element) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `url` (Page URL) | url | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. BlockFlow opens it in its own background tab. Leave empty to read the run's tab instead (see Tab). |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `""` | Used when Page URL is empty: read from this tab of the run (from Open Tab), as it is now, without reloading. |
| `read` (Read) | one of `text`, `value`, `attribute`, `has-class`, `exists`, `count` | `"text"` |  |
| `name` (Attribute / class name) | text | `""` | Only for "an attribute" and "has a class". |
| `reload` (Reload page before reading) | boolean | `true` |  |

Adds to the data: `value` (What was read ("true"/"false" for class and exists).); `previous` (The value from the last run (empty on the first run).); `changed` (True when value differs from previous (false on the first run).); `count` (How many elements matched the selector.); `url` (The page that was read.)

## 🧺 Extract List — `extract-list`

Scrape repeated items (cards, results, rows) into a list of objects.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Each item) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `fields` (Fields) | list of rows {name, locator, attribute} | `[]` | No fields = each item's text as {text}. Links (href, src) come back as full URLs. |
| `limit` (At most (0 = all)) | number | `0` |  |
| `into` (Save the list as) | text | `"items"` |  |
| `source` (From) | one of `tab`, `html` | `"tab"` |  |
| `html` (HTML) | text | `"{{body}}"` | supports `{{…}}`. Only for "HTML in the data". |
| `baseUrl` (Page address) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Makes relative links absolute (HTML mode). |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `items` (The list (or the name you chose).); `count` (How many items.)

## 📊 Extract Table — `extract-table`

Read an HTML table into a list of rows, keyed by its column headers.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Table) | locator | `"table"` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `into` (Save the rows as) | text | `"rows"` |  |
| `source` (From) | one of `tab`, `html` | `"tab"` |  |
| `html` (HTML) | text | `"{{body}}"` | supports `{{…}}`. Only for "HTML in the data". |
| `baseUrl` (Page address) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Makes relative links absolute (HTML mode). |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `rows` (One object per row (or the name you chose).); `count` (How many rows.)

## 📄 Paginate — `paginate`

Run "each" on every page of a paged list, clicking Next in between.

- Outputs (ports): `each`, `done` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 1800s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `next` (Next button) | locator | `"role=link[name=\"Next\"]"` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `maxPages` (At most (pages)) | number | `10` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `page` (On "each": the page number, from 1.); `pages` (On "done": how many pages were visited.)

## ℹ️ Page Info — `page-info`

Read the page itself: title, meta tags, JSON-LD, or its localStorage / cookies.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area` (Read) | one of `page`, `local`, `session`, `cookies` | `"page"` |  |
| `key` (Key (optional)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Storage and cookies: one key. Empty = all of them. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `page` (For "page": url, title, description, canonical, lang, meta, jsonLd, links.); `value` (For storage and cookies: the value (or an object of all of them).)

## ✅ Assert — `assert`

Check that something is true. Fails the run (or just records it, if soft) when it is not.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 10s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subject` (Check) | one of `text`, `input`, `attribute`, `count`, `visible`, `hidden`, `checked`, `unchecked`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `url`, `title`, `value` | `"text"` |  |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For element checks. |
| `name` (Attribute name) | text | `""` | Only for "attribute of an element". |
| `value` (Value) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Only for "a value from the data". |
| `operator` (Must) | one of `equals`, `not-equals`, `contains`, `not-contains`, `starts-with`, `ends-with`, `matches`, `greater`, `greater-equal`, `less`, `less-equal`, `empty`, `not-empty`, `true`, `false` | `"contains"` | Not used by the yes/no checks (visible, checked…). |
| `expected` (Expected) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `message` (Message when it fails) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `soft` (Soft: record the failure but keep going) | boolean | `false` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `actual` (What was found.)

## ✋ Manual Step — `manual-step`

Pause until you press Continue: solve a CAPTCHA, type a 2FA code, take a look.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 600s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` (What to do) | text | `"Solve the CAPTCHA in the open tab, then press Continue."` | required, supports `{{…}}` |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on after you continue.)

- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `outcome` (End as) | one of `fail`, `pass` | `"fail"` |  |
| `message` (Message) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |

## 🔀 If — `if`

Go one way when a condition is true, another when it is false.

- Outputs (ports): `true`, `false` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left` (Value) | text | `"{{value}}"` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `operator` (Condition) | one of `equals`, `not-equals`, `contains`, `not-contains`, `starts-with`, `ends-with`, `matches`, `greater`, `greater-equal`, `less`, `less-equal`, `empty`, `not-empty`, `true`, `false` | `"equals"` |  |
| `right` (Compare to) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Ignored by "is empty", "is true" and similar. For a pattern, write /text/i. |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, unchanged, out of "true" or "false".)

## 🔁 For Each — `for-each`

Repeat the blocks on "each" for every item of a list, then continue from "done".

- Outputs (ports): `each`, `done` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 3600s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list` (List) | text | `"items"` | required. Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}). |
| `as` (Call each item) | text | `"item"` |  |

Adds to the data: `item` (On "each": the current item (or the name you chose).); `index` (On "each": its position, from 0.); `total` (On "each": how many items there are.); `count` (On "done": how many items were processed.)

## 🔂 Repeat — `repeat`

Run the blocks on "each" a number of times, then continue from "done".

- Outputs (ports): `each`, `done` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 3600s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `times` (Times) | number | `3` |  |

Adds to the data: `iteration` (On "each": 1, 2, 3…)

## 🧩 Run Workflow — `run-workflow`

Run another workflow with this data, and continue with what it returns.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 300s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workflow` (Workflow) | workflow id | `""` | required. Its start blocks receive this data. It does not need to be On. |

Adds to the data: `(its data)` (Whatever the called workflow's last block produced.)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (Name) | text | `""` | required |

## 🧮 Transform — `transform`

Compute new values with expressions: math, text, lists (sum, sort, pluck…).

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` (Values) | list of rows {name, expression} | `[{"name":"total","expression":"sum(pluck(items, 'price'))"}]` | required. Expressions without {{ }}. See docs/guide for the functions. |

Adds to the data: `(your names)` (One key per row.)

Keep only the list items that match a condition.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list` (List) | text | `"items"` | required. Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}). |
| `left` (Value (per item)) | text | `"{{item.price}}"` | Rendered for each item: {{item.…}} is the item, other {{…}} the data. |
| `operator` (Condition) | one of `equals`, `not-equals`, `contains`, `not-contains`, `starts-with`, `ends-with`, `matches`, `greater`, `greater-equal`, `less`, `less-equal`, `empty`, `not-empty`, `true`, `false` | `"less"` |  |
| `right` (Compare to) | text | `"50"` |  |
| `into` (Save as (empty = replace the list)) | text | `""` |  |

Adds to the data: `(list)` (The kept items, under the list's name or "Save as".)

## 🗂️ Data Table — `data-table`

Rows of data you paste in (CSV or JSON), e.g. logins to test one by one.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (Data) | text | `"email,password\nfirst@example.com,one\nsecond@example.com,two"` | required. CSV with a header row (comma, semicolon or tab), or a JSON list. |
| `into` (Save the rows as) | text | `"rows"` |  |

Adds to the data: `rows` (The rows (or the name you chose).); `count` (How many rows.)

## 💾 Save to Dataset — `save-dataset`

Add rows to a named dataset kept in the browser. See and download it on the Data page.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset` (Dataset) | text | `"scraped"` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `value` (What to save) | text | `"items"` | required. An expression: a list adds one row per item, anything else one row. E.g. items, or item inside a For Each. Build objects with Transform first. |
| `mode` (Mode) | one of `append`, `replace` | `"append"` |  |

Adds to the data: `datasetSize` (Rows in the dataset afterwards.)

## ⬇️ Download — `download`

Save a list or a dataset to a CSV or JSON file in Downloads.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` (Save) | one of `value`, `dataset` | `"value"` |  |
| `value` (Value) | text | `"items"` | An expression, for "a value from the data". |
| `dataset` (Dataset) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `format` (Format) | one of `csv`, `json`, `text` | `"csv"` |  |
| `filename` (File name) | text | `"blockflow-{{ today() }}.csv"` | required, supports `{{…}}` |

Adds to the data: `file` (The file name used.)

## 🔔 Notify — `notify`

Show a desktop notification.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (Title) | text | `"BlockFlow"` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `message` (Message) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |

Adds to the data: `notified` (Always true once the notification was shown.)

## 🌐 HTTP Request — `http-request`

Call an API or webhook and use the response.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` (URL) | url | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `method` (Method) | one of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` | `"GET"` |  |
| `headers` (Headers) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. One per line, as  Name: value |
| `body` (Body) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Sent for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. |
| `failOnError` (Stop the flow on HTTP errors (4xx, 5xx)) | boolean | `true` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The URL that was called (handy as the base for Extract from HTML).); `status` (HTTP status code.); `ok` (True for 2xx responses.); `body` (Response text.); `data` (Parsed JSON, when the body is JSON.)

## 📝 Log — `log`

Write a line to the run log, e.g. a value you want to see.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` (Message) | text | `"{{value}}"` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `level` (Level) | one of `info`, `warn`, `error`, `debug` | `"info"` |  |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)
